### [268] [pyALDIC: A Python Implementation of Augmented Lagrangian Digital Image Correlation with a GUI, Adaptive Meshing, and Mask-Aware Subset Splitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22755)
*Zixiang Tong,Jin Yang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: pyALDIC是一个开源的Python实现增强拉格朗日数字图像相关法(AL-DIC)软件，用于全场位移和应变测量，支持图形界面、脚本API、自适应四叉树网格、裂口处掩码感知子集分割等功能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提供一个开源、可脚本化、跨平台的全场位移和应变测量工具，弥补现有DIC软件在可重复性和可扩展性方面的不足。

Method: 基于增强拉格朗日数字图像相关法(AL-DIC)，结合图形用户界面与Python API，采用自适应四叉树网格、掩码感知子集分割、Numba加速，支持Local DIC和AL-DIC两种求解器模式。

Result: 通过合成位移场、刚体运动、Mode-I开裂、自适应细化以及实验单轴拉伸等多个验证案例证明了软件的有效性。

Conclusion: pyALDIC通过PyPI、GitHub和Zenodo以BSD-3-Clause许可证公开发布，确保可重复性，可在Windows、macOS和Linux上运行。

Abstract: pyALDIC is an open-source Python implementation of augmented Lagrangian digital image correlation (AL-DIC) for full-field displacement and strain measurement. The software combines a graphical user interface with a scriptable Python API and supports adaptive quadtree meshing, mask-aware subset splitting near cracks and holes, and selectable Local DIC and AL-DIC solver modes. Numba acceleration enables efficient analysis, while automated tests, documentation, and reproducible examples support reliable use acrossWindows, macOS, and Linux. Verification cases include synthetic displacement fields, rigid-body motion, Mode-I cracking, adaptive refinement, and experimental uniaxial tension. pyALDIC is distributed through PyPI, GitHub, and Zenodo under a BSD-3-Clause license for reproducibility. pyALDIC is openly available at https://github.com/zachtong/pyALDIC.

</details>


### [269] [Frequency-Aware Dual-Stream Learning for Balanced Realism and Fidelity in Electron Microscopy Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22765)
*Longmi Gao,Zhengkai Zhao,Pan Gao,Manoranjan Paul*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出频域自适应双流架构，结合条件扩散模型和Transformer，在电子显微镜成像中平衡感知真实性与定量保真度，实现快速高分辨率成像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电子显微镜成像方法面临分辨率与采集速度的权衡，单流架构难以兼顾感知真实性与定量保真度，导致过度平滑或产生不真实幻觉的问题。

Method: 采用离散小波变换将图像分解为低频结构和高频细节，通过条件扩散模型进行全局真实感合成，同时使用Transformer网络进行精确细节恢复，形成频域自适应双流架构。

Result: 在EMDiffuse数据集上，该方法在LPIPS和分辨率指标上显著优于现有方法，并展现出跨多种生物样本的强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该方法有效支持快速可靠的电子显微镜成像，对结构生物学和纳米技术应用具有重要价值，且开源代码与数据集便于后续研究。

Abstract: Electron microscopy enables nanoscale cellular visualization but faces a trade-off between imaging resolution and acquisition speed. Existing learning-based methods rely on single-stream architectures that struggle to balance perceptual realism and quantitative fidelity, either over-smoothing details or generating unrealistic hallucinations. This work introduces a frequency-adaptive dual-stream architecture to resolve this conflict. Using discrete wavelet transform, we decompose images into low-frequency structures and high-frequency details, then employ a conditional diffusion model for realistic global synthesis and a transformer network for precise detail recovery. Experiments on the EMDiffuse dataset show the method achieves superior LPIPS and resolution ratio, substantially outperforming existing approaches. The method also shows strong generalization across diverse biological samples, supporting fast and reliable electron microscopy imaging for structural biology and nanotechnology applications. The source code and associated dataset are publicly available to facilitate further research.

</details>


### [270] [Generative Video Compression with Adaptive Score Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22772)
*Naifu Xue,Zhaoyang Jia,Haosen Li,Zihan Zheng,Jiahao Li,Bin Li,Xiaoyi Zhang,Qi Meng,Yuan Zhang,Yan Lu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: GenVC是首个专为压缩设计的视频扩散模型，采用像素空间全局到局部层次结构，并结合自适应得分蒸馏（Adaptive Score Distillation）解决分布匹配蒸馏中的运动停滞问题，在超低比特率下达到SOTA感知质量，参数量仅478M，单步解码1080p视频达15.1fps。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的视频压缩方法均借用为文本条件生成设计的基模型，缺乏专门为压缩任务训练和设计的扩散模型。作者旨在填补这一空白，构建首个面向压缩的视频扩散模型。

Method: 1) 从零训练的像素空间视频扩散模型，采用全局到局部层次结构恢复细粒度时空细节；2) 使用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）将多步推理蒸馏为单步；3) 提出自适应得分蒸馏（Adaptive Score Distillation），根据梯度与真实方向的对齐程度门控DMD更新，打破因教师侧引导失败导致的运动停滞反馈循环。

Result: 在超低比特率下达到SOTA感知质量，与GLVC相比，在匹配LPIPS时平均节省62.5%比特率，匹配FID时节省71.3%。模型仅478M参数，在A100上单步解码1080p视频达15.1fps。

Conclusion: GenVC验证了专为压缩设计的视频扩散模型在超低比特率下的优越性，且无需依赖大规模预训练骨干网络，在效率与质量之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: Diffusion models provide strong generative capabilities for video compression at ultra-low bitrates. Existing diffusion-based video codecs adapt base models originally developed for text-conditioned generation, whereas diffusion models designed and trained specifically for compression remain unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce our Generative Video Codec (GenVC), built on a video diffusion model trained from scratch for compression. To our knowledge, this is the first compression-oriented video diffusion model. We realize this model directly in pixel space with a global-to-local hierarchy that recovers fine spatio-temporal details, enabling high-quality generative reconstruction from compressed representations. To accelerate inference, we distill the multi-step model into one step using distribution matching distillation (DMD). Applying DMD directly, however, drives the student toward motion-stalled reconstructions. We trace this to a teacher-side guidance failure: once student-induced perturbations leave the frozen teacher's training region, its guidance can become misleading, causing DMD updates to reinforce rather than correct the student drift. To break the resulting feedback loop, we propose Adaptive Score Distillation, which gates DMD updates according to their alignment with the ground-truth direction, enabling high-quality reconstruction with coherent motion. Experimental results show that GenVC achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, with average bitrate savings of 62.5% at matched LPIPS and 71.3% at matched FID over GLVC. Unlike prior codecs that inherit billion-scale pretrained backbones, our diffusion model has only 478.0M parameters and decodes 1080p video in a single step at 15.1 fps on an A100 GPU.

</details>


### [271] [Metric Surface Reconstruction of Neurosurgical Scenes from Monocular Operating Microscope Images and Microscope Pose](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22773)
*Thomas Bucher,Didier Neuenschwander,Thomas Petutschnigg,Michael Murek,David Bervini,Andreas Raabe,Manuela Eugster*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于标准单目手术显微镜图像与导航位姿数据相结合的方法，利用预训练的Depth Anything 3模型（无需微调）重建手术暴露区域的毫米级三维几何结构。在体模实验中，重建精度在1.02±0.93 mm到2.33±2.15 mm之间，证明了技术可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经外科手术中，客观量化手术暴露区域的三维几何结构对于手术规划、器械设计及图像融合具有重要意义。然而，现有方法通常依赖专用设备或复杂设置，缺乏从标准单目显微镜图像中高效恢复三维几何的可行性方案。

Method: 利用ZEISS Pentero 800显微镜与Brainlab导航系统同步获取单目显微镜图像与位姿数据；通过内外参标定后，使用预训练的Depth Anything 3模型估计深度，无需任务特定微调；将融合点云通过泊松表面重建转化为网格；与结构光扫描和CT参考表面对比评估精度。

Result: 在深部手术通路体模A上，重建精度为1.95±1.70 mm至2.33±2.15 mm；在浅表暴露体模B上，精度为1.02±0.93 mm至1.52±1.21 mm。更大图像集主要提升重建完整性，精度变化范围较小。通道路径分析显示整体几何结构得以保持，局部偏差出现在未完全重建区域。

Conclusion: 标准单目显微镜图像结合导航位姿数据，可通过基于基础模型（Depth Anything 3）的流水线实现毫米级三维表面重建。该结果在可控体模环境中验证了技术可行性，为手术暴露客观量化、图像融合及手术器械工作空间表征提供了支持。

Abstract: Objective: We evaluated whether metric 3D geometry of neurosurgical operative exposure can be recovered from standard monocular operating-microscope images combined with microscope pose data.
  Methods: In a phantom-based laboratory study, two aneurysm training phantoms were imaged with a ZEISS Pentero 800 microscope integrated with Brainlab Cranial Navigation. Microscope images from the standard composite video output were stored with synchronous microscope poses. After intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, depth was estimated with the pretrained Depth Anything 3 model without task-specific fine-tuning. Fused point clouds were converted to meshes using Poisson surface reconstruction. Reconstructions were compared with reference surfaces from structured-light scanning and fine-slice CT.
  Results: For phantom A, representing a deeper surgical corridor, reconstruction accuracy ranged from 1.95 $\pm$ 1.70 mm to 2.33 $\pm$ 2.15 mm. For phantom B, representing a directly exposed surface, accuracy ranged from 1.02 $\pm$ 0.93 mm to 1.52 $\pm$ 1.21 mm. Larger image sets mainly improved completeness, while accuracy remained within a narrower range. Corridor analysis showed preservation of overall geometry with local deviations in incompletely reconstructed regions.
  Conclusions: Standard monocular microscope images combined with navigation-derived pose data can reconstruct millimeter-range 3D surfaces using a foundation-model-based pipeline. These results show technical feasibility in a controlled phantom setting and support further development toward objective quantification of operative exposure, image fusion, and characterization of working spaces for future surgical instrumentation.

</details>


### [272] [Codebook Capacity Governs Perceptual Quality Across Resolutions in Hierarchical Discrete Video Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23366)
*Manikanta Kotthapalli,Banafsheh Rekabdar*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文研究层次化离散视频编码（MS-VQ-VAE）在不同空间分辨率下的表现，发现码本大小（codebook size）是影响感知压缩质量的主导因素，而空间分辨率影响不显著。所有分辨率和码本大小下，模型在LPIPS指标上均优于H.264/H.265。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续潜在表示的视频编码器在扩展到新分辨率时需要重新训练或率失真校准，作者想探究层次化离散编码器是否也存在同样问题。

Method: 对MS-VQ-VAE视频压缩进行控制实验，变化码本大小K∈{128,256,512,1024}和分辨率64×64、128×128、256×256，在UCF101上拟合对数线性模型Q(K,r)=αlog₂K+βlog₂r+γ。

Result: α=-0.0094 (p<0.001)，β=-0.0009 (p=0.68不显著)，R²=0.82。码本容量影响约是分辨率的10倍。熵效率随分辨率稳定或提升。模型在LPIPS上优于H.264（25-52%）和H.265（21-37%）。

Conclusion: 码本大小K而非空间分辨率是层次化离散视频编码中感知压缩质量的主导设计变量，可简化多分辨率部署并指导可扩展离散分词器的设计。

Abstract: Learned video codecs based on continuous latent representations typically require resolution-specific retraining or rate-distortion (RD) recalibration when scaling to new spatial resolutions, because entropy models and Lagrangian weights are tightly coupled to the operating point. We investigate whether hierarchical discrete latent codecs exhibit the same sensitivity. Using a controlled empirical study of MS-VQ-VAE video compression across codebook sizes $K \in \{128,256,512,1024\}$ and resolutions $64\times64$, $128\times128$, and $256\times256$ on UCF101, we show that perceptual quality (LPIPS) depends strongly on codebook capacity but only negligibly on spatial resolution. Fitting a log-linear model $Q(K,r) = α\log_2 K + β\log_2 r + γ$ to all 12 operating points yields $α=-0.0094$ ($t=-6.6$, $p<0.001$) and $β=-0.0009$ ($t=-0.43$, $p=0.68$, not significant), with $R^2=0.82$. Codebook capacity is therefore roughly $10\times$ more influential than spatial resolution per log-unit increase. In parallel, bottom-level entropy efficiency $η=H(z)/\log_2 K$ remains stable or improves with resolution (84-87% at $64\times64$; 92-94% at $256\times256$), confirming that larger spatial grids are utilized more efficiently rather than less. Across all resolutions and codebook sizes, our models outperform H.264 on LPIPS at matched or lower bitrate, with gains of 25-52% at $128\times128$ and 21-37% over H.265 at $256\times256$. These findings suggest that codebook size $K$, not spatial resolution, is the dominant design variable governing perceptual compression quality in hierarchical discrete video codecs -- a property that may simplify multi-resolution deployment and inform the design of scalable discrete tokenizers for generative video models.

</details>


### [273] [JPEG AIC2026: A large-scale dataset for fine-grained assessment of image coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22783)
*Mohsen Jenadeleh,Jon Sneyers,João Ascenso,Thomas Richter,Alexander Karabutov,Panqi Jia,Elena Alshina,Osamu Watanabe,António Pinheiro,Touradj Ebrahimi,Dietmar Saupe*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了AIC2026，一个包含70张源图像、9,618张失真图像的大规模高保真图像压缩基准数据集，覆盖8种传统和4种学习型编解码器在20个感知失真水平下的压缩效果，并通过24种传统和12种学习型IQA方法评估发现现有方法对细粒度质量差异（尤其学习型编解码器伪影）存在显著分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像压缩基准数据集缺乏对学习型图像压缩方法细粒度质量评估的支持，需要构建一个覆盖多种编解码器、精细采样失真水平的规模化数据集。

Method: 从2,787个候选图像中通过语义聚类、客观IQA方法间分歧分析和人工检查筛选出70张源图像；使用8种传统和4种学习型编解码器，以CVVDP度量在0.2-4.0 JND范围内按20个感知间隔失真水平编码，共生成9,618张失真图像；使用24种传统和12种学习型IQA方法进行客观分析。

Result: 生成了包含9,618张失真图像的数据集；客观分析显示当前IQA方法对细粒度质量差异存在显著分歧，尤其对学习型编解码器引入的伪影。

Conclusion: AIC2026数据集为高保真图像压缩的细粒度质量评估提供了丰富基准，揭示了现有IQA方法在评估学习型编解码器伪影方面的不足。

Abstract: Recent advances in conventional and learning-based image coding have increased the demand for benchmark datasets that support fine-grained assessment of compressed image quality, particularly for learning-based image compression methods. This paper introduces Assessment of Image Coding 2026 (AIC2026), a large-scale dataset for high-fidelity image compression containing 70 source images selected from 2,787 candidates using semantic clustering, inter-metric disagreement among objective image quality assessment (IQA) methods, and manual inspection and refinement. The dataset covers a wide range of compression artifacts produced by eight conventional and four learning-based codecs across 17 coding configurations. Each source image is encoded using seven codecs. For each source-codec pair, decoded images are provided at 20 perceptually spaced distortion levels, corresponding approximately to 0.2-4.0 just-noticeable difference (JND) units using the ColorVideoVDP (CVVDP) metric for distortion estimation, yielding 9,618 distorted images. This fine-grained sampling enables analysis of rate-distortion behavior and objective metric evaluation for subtle quality differences across a wide range of compression artifacts. We report an extensive objective analysis using 24 conventional and 12 learning-based IQA methods. The results show substantial disagreement among current IQA methods for fine-grained quality differences, particularly for artifacts introduced by learning-based codecs. The complete dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.18419/DARUS-6156.

</details>


### [274] [Learning-based Hierarchical Tracheal Anatomy Understanding from Sparse Surgical Demonstration Annotations for Ultrasound Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22789)
*Hiu Ching Cheung,Wenchao Yue,Zhengran Han,Mingcong Chen,Guanglin Cao,Hongbin Liu,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于YOLOv8n定位骨干与稀疏提示优化SAM2解码器的两阶段感知框架，用于超声引导下机器人气管切开术中的气管解剖层次理解，在保持6.92 FPS推理速度的同时，在两个领域均取得0.777的平均Dice相似系数，显著优于U-Net基线（泛化DSC≤0.494）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统气管切开术依赖手动触诊定位气管切口位置，但该方法主观性强且不可靠；超声虽可辅助定位，但其效用高度依赖操作者经验。因此需要一种自动化、标准化的感知方法，以提升机器人辅助气管切开术的安全性与精度。

Method: 提出两阶段感知流水线：第一阶段使用YOLOv8n作为轻量级定位骨干，从超声图像中检测目标区域；第二阶段采用稀疏提示优化的SAM2解码器，从少量手术标注中学习高保真分割掩码。通过混合训练策略（融合实验室标注数据与非约束序列）增强临床鲁棒性。

Result: YOLOv8n+SAM2框架在受控域与泛化域均达到0.777的平均Dice相似系数（DSC），显著优于U-Net基线（泛化域DSC≤0.494）。推理吞吐量达6.92 FPS，满足闭环机器人遥操作需求。

Conclusion: 通过将轻量级定位与基础视觉模型耦合，能够实现鲁棒的气管解剖层次理解，为标准化、自主化的手术辅助系统奠定可扩展基础，有效应对真实超声图像的可变性，提升机器人辅助气管切开术的安全性与精度。

Abstract: Tracheostomy requires precise localization of the tracheal incision site; however, conventional manual palpation is subjective and often unreliable, while ultrasound utility remains operator-dependent. This work presents a learning-based framework for hierarchical tracheal anatomy understanding, designed specifically for ultrasound-guided robotic systems. We propose a two-stage perception pipeline integrating a YOLOv8n localization backbone with a sparse, prompt-optimized SAM2 decoder to achieve high-fidelity segmentation from sparse surgical annotations. Our hybrid training strategy, bridging curated laboratory data with unconstrained sequences, ensures clinical robustness. Experimental benchmarks demonstrate that this decoupled architecture effectively balances generalization, precision, and efficiency. The YOLOv8n and SAM2 framework achieves a consistent Mean Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 0.777 across both controlled and generalized domains. This significantly outperforms U-Net baselines, which often suffer from anatomical fragmentation and performance degradation (Generalization DSC $\le$ 0.494). By constraining mask decoding to targeted, sparse regions of interest, our model achieves a throughput of 6.92 FPS, which is vital for closed-loop robotic teleoperation. This study confirms that a robust hierarchical understanding of tracheal anatomy can be derived by coupling lightweight localization with foundation-scale visual models. Our framework establishes a scalable foundation for standardized, autonomous surgical assistance, effectively navigating the variability of real-world ultrasound to enhance the safety and precision of robotic-assisted tracheostomy.

</details>


### [275] [Small, Bias-Free, Blind and Convolutional Denoiser: A compact ConvNeXt U-Net for blind Gaussian color-image denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22793)
*Nikolas Markou*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种紧凑型无偏置ConvNeXt U-Net（BF-ConvUNeXt），用于盲彩色图像去噪。该网络通过组合四种现有技术实现端到端的一阶齐次性，仅需0.82M参数即可跨噪声水平泛化，在多个标准数据集上匹配或超越DnCNN和FFDNet，并以极小的参数代价逼近重型方法性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有盲去噪模型通常无法在广泛的噪声水平上良好泛化，且高性能模型参数量巨大。作者希望设计一种紧凑、参数高效且能真正实现盲泛化（跨噪声级别）的去噪网络。

Method: 1) 冻结的深度方向Gabor茎（零可训练参数，定向带通）；2) 拉普拉斯金字塔编码器，将高频残差路由到每个跳跃连接；3) ConvNeXt-V1 U-Net主体；4) 全无偏置构造（无加性偏置、线性头、LeakyReLU、仅方差批归一化）。这些设计使网络在推理时呈现精确的度-1齐次性D(αy)=αD(y)，从而实现对噪声水平的盲泛化。

Result: 在CBSD68、Kodak24、McMaster、Urban100数据集上，σ∈{15,25,50}下匹配或超越DnCNN和FFDNet，平均高出约0.7dB；在σ=150时22.8dB、σ=200时20.0dB，无悬崖式退化；参数量仅为重型CNN/Transformer的1/15至1/39，性能差距约0.3-1.7dB。

Conclusion: BF-ConvUNeXt证明了通过精心设计的结构归纳偏置（无偏置、齐次性）可以实现紧凑高效的盲去噪，并支持下游任务（如随机采样、线性逆问题），但其齐次性仅推理有效且学习到的残差为局部得分，不适用于即插即用/RED保证。

Abstract: We describe and evaluate BF-ConvUNeXt, a compact bias-free ConvNeXt U-Net for blind additive-white-Gaussian-noise color image denoising, combining four existing ingredients so a single property survives end to end: a frozen depthwise Gabor stem (oriented band-pass, zero trainable parameters), a Laplacian-pyramid encoder routing the high-frequency residual into each skip connection, a ConvNeXt-V1 U-Net body, and bias-free construction throughout (no additive bias, linear head, LeakyReLU, variance-only batch norm). Together these make the 0.82M-parameter network exactly degree-1 homogeneous at inference, D(alpha y) = alpha D(y), licensing a Miyasawa/Tweedie score reading of the residual and blind generalization across noise levels from one model. We train a single blind model on a noise-sigma curriculum (sigma approximately 6.4 to 64, 0-255 scale); it extrapolates past that ceiling without a cliff, degrading smoothly to 22.8 dB at sigma=150 and 20.0 dB at sigma=200. Evaluated unchanged on four standard color sets (CBSD68, Kodak24, McMaster, Urban100) at sigma in {15,25,50}, it matches or beats DnCNN and FFDNet on every set and level, averaging about +0.7 dB over DnCNN. Against heavyweight CNN/transformer state of the art it trails by a small margin (roughly 0.3-1.7 dB depending on set) at 1/15 to 1/39 of their parameters. The homogeneity is inference-only and checkpoint-specific, and the learned residual is a local, not global, score (non-conservative Jacobian), so plug-and-play/RED guarantees do not transfer; it still drives stochastic sampling and linear inverse problems (inpainting, super-resolution, deblurring, compressive sensing).

</details>


### [276] [DY-LUT: Depth-Aware YCbCr Lookup Tables for Real-Time Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22801)
*Cunhao Zhu,Xiangtao Kong,Dongliang Xu,Zhiheng Zhang,Tianyu Wang,Yue Yao*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出DY-LUT框架，利用YCbCr色彩空间和深度感知的4D查找表实现高效水下图像增强，在保持实时性能的同时达到竞争性质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下图像退化具有空间非均匀和波长依赖特性，现有方法难以兼顾增强质量与实时效率，需要一种物理引导的高效增强方案。

Method: 设计深度感知的YCbCr查找表框架，包含双分支编码器预测融合权重和退化指数，通过可学习的4D LUT进行条件化增强，并附加轻量级局部精化模块。

Result: 3.56M参数的增强网络在UIEB-90和LSUI数据集上达到竞争性质量，运行速度比高容量基线快9-304倍，4K图像推理仅需7ms，并提升下游检测与特征匹配性能。

Conclusion: YCbCr比RGB更适合深度条件化查找表，联合学习的退化指数进一步改善自适应查询，为实际平台上的高效水下图像增强提供了物理可行的路径。

Abstract: Underwater image enhancement is challenged by spatially non-uniform, wavelength-dependent attenuation. Propagation distance and wavelength govern this degradation, while YCbCr separates luminance from chrominance for restoration. We propose DY-LUT, a depth-aware YCbCr lookup-table framework for real-time enhancement. A dual-branch encoder predicts image-level fusion weights and a joint pair of pixel-wise degradation indices from image and depth features. These quantities condition learnable 4D LUTs, followed by lightweight local refinement. DY-LUT preserves traditional LUT efficiency while enabling depth-conditioned, spatially adaptive restoration. With externally supplied depth, its 3.56M-parameter enhancement network achieves competitive quality on UIEB-90 and LSUI and runs $9$--$304\times$ faster than representative high-capacity baselines. Adaptive inference further maintains real-time performance ($\sim7$ ms) for 4K UIQAD images. DY-LUT also benefits downstream detection and feature matching. Ablations show that YCbCr is a more effective basis than RGB for depth-conditioned lookup, while the jointly learned indices further improve adaptive querying. These results provide a physically grounded route to efficient UIE on practical platforms.

</details>


### [277] [Learning Dense 2D-3D Correspondence for X-ray-to-CT Registration of Knee Bones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22803)
*Rembert Daems,Jonas Grammens,Caro Roten,Andrew Meyer,Thomas Luyckx,Matthias Verstraete*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于学习的方法，从单张X光片恢复膝关节6自由度姿态，通过训练一个骨骼通用的密集2D-3D对应关系模型，仅需投影几何监督，即可实现初始化-free、无需渲染的PnP+RANSAC求解，在758名患者的训练集上表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法（基于轮廓匹配或可微渲染）在单视角下存在深度模糊、捕获范围窄、逐患者优化效率低等问题，亟需一种鲁棒且高效的姿态估计方法。

Method: 学习一个与患者无关的密集2D-3D对应关系，每个骨骼使用一个共享权重的模型，在758名患者数据上训练；采用透射感知的对应目标（而非单一表面）；姿态通过PnP+RANSAC全局闭式求解，无需初始化或渲染。

Result: 模型在大型单机构队列中成功泛化到未见过的患者；学到的表示具有解剖语义，可用于分类解剖区域和无标签的骨骼身份区分。

Conclusion: 该方法通过端到端学习密集对应，克服了传统单视角膝关节姿态估计的局限性，兼具鲁棒性和效率。

Abstract: Recovering the 6-DoF pose of the knee bones from a plain radiograph, given the patient's segmented pre-operative CT, turns a routine low-dose image into a quantitative measurement of joint geometry, without the added dose of a repeat CT or a fixed biplanar rig. Classic solutions align a rendered bone silhouette to image edges; recent alternatives refine pose by backpropagating an image-similarity loss through a differentiable X-ray renderer. Both operate one patient at a time and are fragile under a single view. Silhouettes are depth-ambiguous, and differentiable-rendering refinement has a narrow capture range at substantial per-iteration cost. We instead learn an amortized, subject-agnostic dense 2D-3D correspondence, supervised solely by projection geometry. One shared-weight model per bone, trained across 758 patients, registers patients unseen during training. The pose then follows in closed form from a global, initialization-free, render-free PnP+RANSAC solve. Because X-ray formation is transmissive, our correspondence target is transmission-aware rather than tied to a single surface. Though trained only to register, the representation is anatomically semantic: a simple classifier reads a landmark's anatomical region from its embedding across held-out patients, and the same features separate the knee's bones into a 2D-3D-consistent identity learned without any bone label. On a large single-institution cohort the model generalizes well to held-out patients.

</details>


### [278] [PriSAR: 3D Geometric-Prior-Guided Diffusion for Parameter-Controlled SAR Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22963)
*Fan Zhang,Xuanting Wu,Fei Ma,Qiang Yin,Yuxin Hu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: GeoDiff-SAR利用轻量级3D几何先验（多弹跳光线追踪点云）引导扩散模型，在稀疏观测角度下实现可控的SAR图像生成（中间方位角补全），在真实飞机数据集和MSTAR车辆数据集上显著提升了图像质量与方位角一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR图像生成可缓解数据稀缺问题，但现有方法在稀疏观测角度下的可控生成和显式几何感知控制方面仍存在不足。

Method: 构建轻量级多弹跳光线追踪先验，编码生成的点云，融合文本条件，通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium，实现中间方位角补全。

Result: 在四类飞机数据集上SSIM达0.812，方位角一致性0.940（基线分别为0.738和0.782）；在MSTAR五类车辆数据上SSIM达0.878，方位角一致性0.917。

Conclusion: 轻量级3D几何先验能有效提升可控SAR生成的视角一致性，但该先验旨在提供生成引导，而非高保真电磁重建。

Abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image generation can mitigate data scarcity, but controllablegeneration under sparse observation angles remains difficult. Recent SAR generative studies im-prove texture realism, yet explicit geometry-aware control is still limited. This paper studiesthe focused and verifiable setting of intermediate-azimuth completion: 3D-model-derived geo-metric priors guide a diffusion model to synthesize the views missing from sparse-angle trainingdata. GeoDiff-SAR constructs a lightweight multi-bounce ray-tracing prior, encodes the result-ing point cloud, and fuses it with text conditioning while adapting Stable Diffusion 3.5 Mediumthrough low-rank adaptation. On a real four-category aircraft dataset, GeoDiff-SAR reaches anSSIM of 0.812 and azimuth consistency of 0.940, compared with 0.738 and 0.782 for the text-conditioned SD3.5 Medium baseline. The same sparse-angle protocol on five MSTAR vehicleclasses yields an SSIM of 0.878 and azimuth consistency of 0.917. These results support theconclusion that a lightweight 3D geometric prior improves viewpoint adherence for controllableSAR generation; it is intended as generation guidance rather than high-fidelity electromagneticreconstruction.

</details>


### [279] [Optimized Embedded Implementation of Hyperspectral-Multispectral Image Fusion on Raspberry Pi](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23136)
*Salah Eddine Brezini,Okba Bekhelifi,Oussama Mezouar,Chams Eddine Choucha,Sarra Boukhacheba,Fethi Abdelatif Dali*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文针对树莓派上高光谱超分辨率处理耗时的问题，通过将核心计算迁移至PyTorch、ONNX Runtime和ExecuTorch（XNNPACK后端）进行优化，在树莓派5上实现了1.48倍加速（从527.1ms降至356.7ms），融合质量保持不变，使其更适合无人机等边缘计算场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱图像数据量大，在资源受限的嵌入式平台（如树莓派）上实时处理困难，原有HSB-SV超分辨率方法在树莓派上计算时间过长，亟需优化以满足边缘计算场景需求。

Method: 采用计算优化技术，将最密集的计算操作迁移到PyTorch以及ONNX Runtime和ExecuTorch（XNNPACK后端）等边缘推理框架，在树莓派5平台上部署优化后的实现。

Result: 总执行时间从527.1ms降至356.7ms，加速比1.48倍，耗时减少32.3%，且融合质量完全保持不变。

Conclusion: 所提出的优化方法显著降低了嵌入式平台上的计算时间，使高光谱超分辨率技术更适用于无人机等边缘计算场景。

Abstract: Remote sensing optical images have become central to a wide range of applications. In particular, hyperspectral images, with their high spectral resolution, enable the extraction of rich information about the objects and materials present in the observed scene. Nevertheless, processing such data comes at the expense of a high computational load due to its large data volume, making real-time processing very difficult to achieve. Recently, we proposed an approach to investigate the feasibility of processing such data on a Raspberry Pi by implementing a hyperspectral super-resolution technique, namely HSB-SV. However, the implementation resulted in high computational time. To overcome this limitation, we apply computational optimization techniques based on migrating the most intensive operations to PyTorch and edge inference frameworks such as ONNX Runtime and ExecuTorch with the XNNPACK backend. The proposed optimized implementation is deployed on a Raspberry Pi 5 platform. Experimental results demonstrate a significant reduction in computational time, achieving a 1.48x overall speedup on the Raspberry Pi 5, the total execution time decreases significantly, from 527.1 ms to 356.7 ms corresponding to a 32.3% dminution, while fully preserving the fusion quality, making the approach more suitable for embedded and edge computing scenarios, particularly for UAV-based hyperspectral remote sensing applications.

</details>


### [280] [A Reference-Free Framework for Evaluating Single-Frame ISP Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23321)
*Yujin Cho,Sira Ferradans,Jean-Michel Morel,Gabriele Facciolo,Thomas Eboli*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无参考学习框架，通过处理后的sRGB图像及其ISO元数据，预测代理参考图像，进而计算PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS等全参考图像质量指标，用于评估相机ISP管线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全参考指标需要完美对齐的图像对，实际应用中难以获取；而盲图像质量评估（BIQA）主要关注语义和高层视觉线索，无法捕捉相机管线引入的低层次处理伪影。

Method: 提出无参考学习框架：从处理后的sRGB图像和ISO元数据预测代理参考图像，再通过代理参考与处理图像计算PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS等全参考指标；采用合成数据训练并迁移到真实相机数据，使用轻量级LoRA微调适应不同的ISP组件或管线配置。

Result: 该方法在估计指标值上优于直接指标回归，在排名一致性上比传统盲IQA方法更接近真正的全参考指标排序；可从合成数据学习并泛化到真实相机数据，LoRA微调可高效适应不同ISP配置。

Conclusion: 证明了在无参考条件下估计全参考图像质量指标的可行性，为实际相机管线评估提供了一种实用的无参考方案。

Abstract: Evaluating camera image signal processing (ISP) pipelines requires measuring low-level artifacts introduced by operations such as denoising, demosaicing, tone mapping, and compression. Blind image quality assessment (IQA) techniques can grade visual quality without a reference, but they typically focus on semantic and high-level visual cues or human perceptual scores rather than the low-level image-processing artifacts introduced by camera pipelines. In contrast, full-reference metrics such as PSNR and SSIM measure pixel-level differences and structural similarity, while LPIPS measures perceptual similarity in deep feature space. However, these metrics require perfectly aligned image pairs, which are difficult to collect in practical settings. We propose a reference-free learning framework that estimates full-reference image quality metrics from a processed sRGB image and its ISO metadata. Our method predicts a proxy sRGB reference, which is then compared with the processed image to compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS in their standard full-reference form. Our experiments show that the proxy-reference model can be learned from synthetic data and applied to real camera data. We further show that lightweight LoRA fine-tuning enables efficient adaptation when ISP components or pipeline configurations are changed. The proposed method outperforms direct metric regression in estimating metric values and achieves higher agreement with full-reference rankings than conventional blind IQA methods. These results demonstrate the feasibility of reference-free estimation of full-reference metrics for practical camera-pipeline evaluation.

</details>


### [281] [Stabilizing Deep Reconstruction Operators with Contractive Anchoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23341)
*Arghya Sinha,Trishit Mukherjee,Kunal N. Chaudhury*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的稳定化框架，通过控制不稳定图像重建算子的局部量，并引入可训练的收缩算子作为锚点，有效防止了PnP和RED算法在迭代过程中的“先升后降”崩溃问题，无需重新训练或修改预训练去噪网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的PnP和RED算法在使用预训练去噪器作为正则化项时，迭代过程中容易出现PSNR先提升后突然下降的“peak-and-collapse”不稳定行为，导致算法在实际应用中不可靠。本文旨在形式化这种不稳定性并提出解决方案。

Method: 提出一个数据驱动的稳定化框架：(i) 通过局部量形式化任何IR算子的不稳定性；(ii) 自适应正则化该局部量以防止崩溃，无需重新训练或修改预训练网络；(iii) 用收缩算子作为锚点控制不稳定的IR算子；(iv) 引入高效可训练的收缩算子族作为强锚点。

Result: 在多种近端算法、去噪器架构、噪声水平和成像任务上的大量实验表明，该方法实现了一致的、无崩溃的性能，显著提升了PnP和RED重建的可靠性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的稳定化框架有效解决了PnP/RED算法中的不稳定问题，通过引入收缩算子作为锚点，在不增加训练负担的前提下提升了算法的实用性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Pretrained deep denoisers can be used to solve a wide range of model-based image reconstruction tasks via Plug-and-Play (PnP) and Regularization-by-Denoising (RED) algorithms, without retraining per task. These denoisers are trained only for single-step denoising. Using them as Image Reconstruction (IR) regularizers in an iterative process can destabilize reconstruction. A common failure mode is the peak-and-collapse behaviour: metrics such as PSNR improve for early iterations and then abruptly degrade, making these algorithms unreliable in practice. We propose a data-driven stabilization framework that (i) formalizes this instability of any IR operator through a local quantity and (ii) prevents collapse by regularizing this quantity adaptively, requiring no retraining or modification of the given pretrained network. Our key idea is to control the potentially unstable IR operator with a contractive operator whose stable iterates act as an anchor and prevent collapse. We further introduce an efficient family of trainable contractive operators that serve as strong anchors while remaining lightweight. Extensive experiments across proximal algorithms, denoiser architectures, noise levels, and imaging tasks show consistent, collapse-free performance and improved reliability of PnP and RED reconstruction.

</details>


### [282] [Patient-Agnostic Synthetic Pretraining for Efficient Patient-Specific Intraoperative 2D/3D Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23343)
*Minheng Chen,Youyong Kong*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于患者无关合成预训练和球面相似性学习的高效患者特异性2D/3D配准框架，在降低患者特异性训练成本的同时保持高精度配准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的患者特异性2D/3D配准方法需要为每位新患者从头训练模型，计算效率低下，限制了临床实际部署。

Method: 1) 在多个CT生成的合成DRR上进行患者无关预训练，学习可迁移的位姿敏感表征；2) 使用少量目标CT合成投影进行快速患者适应；3) 引入无需分割的域随机化策略提升合成到真实的鲁棒性；4) 结合球面相似性学习和可微Levenberg-Marquardt优化进行位姿精炼。

Result: 患者无关的合成预训练能够显著降低患者特异性训练需求，同时保持精确的术中2D/3D配准精度。

Conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了患者特异性配准的计算效率瓶颈，在适应成本与配准精度之间取得了良好平衡，具有临床部署潜力。

Abstract: Intraoperative 2D/3D registration aligns preoperative CT volumes with intraoperative X-ray or fluoroscopic images and is essential for image-guided interventions. Recent learning-based and differentiable registration methods have shown promising accuracy, especially in patient-specific settings where abundant digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) can be synthesized from the target CT. However, training a separate patient-specific model from scratch for every new patient is computationally inefficient and limits practical deployment. In this work, we propose an efficient patient-specific 2D/3D registration framework based on patient-agnostic synthetic pretraining and spherical similarity learning. The model is first pretrained on synthetic DRRs generated from multiple CT volumes to learn transferable pose-sensitive representations, and is then adapted to a new patient using only a limited number of synthetic projections from the target CT. To improve synthetic-to-real robustness without requiring anatomical labels, we introduce a segmentation-free domain randomization strategy that perturbs image intensity, projection physics, field-of-view, occlusion, and fluoroscopic artifacts. The adapted model provides an initial pose estimate, which is further refined using spherical similarity learning and differentiable Levenberg-Marquardt optimization. Experiments on multiple anatomical datasets evaluate whether patient-agnostic synthetic pretraining can improve the efficiency of patient-specific registration, with particular focus on the trade-off between adaptation cost and registration accuracy. The results demonstrate that patient-agnostic synthetic pretraining can significantly reduce patient-specific training requirements while preserving accurate intraoperative 2D/3D registration.

</details>


### [283] [Trainable Nonexpansive Denoisers for Contractive Image Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23347)
*Arghya Sinha,Aditya Banerjee,Trishit Mukherjee,Kunal N. Chaudhury*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种通过排列操作约束神经网络架构实现全局非扩张性（Lipschitz界≤1）的方法，并将其与成像算子结合构建了全局收敛的图像重建机制，在超分辨率和去模糊任务中性能与软约束基线相当且具备Lipschitz保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可训练去噪器仅经验性控制Lipschitz常数，无法提供训练数据外的全局保证，而强去噪性能与全局Lipschitz保证难以兼得。

Method: 利用排列作用于图像网格的特性，设计全局非扩张性（Lipschitz界≤1）的神经网络架构；将去噪器与前向成像算子集成，构建可证明为收缩映射的重建机制。

Result: 在超分辨率和去模糊等标准逆问题中，所提方法在重建性能上与软约束基线相当，同时提供了严格的Lipschitz保证。

Conclusion: 通过排列操作约束网络架构可以在不牺牲性能的前提下实现全局Lipschitz保证，为收敛性图像重建提供了新思路。

Abstract: Trainable denoisers with Lipschitz control have become central to convergent image reconstruction. However, training neural networks that simultaneously offer strong denoising performance and global Lipschitz guarantees is challenging. Existing approaches enforce Lipschitz control only empirically, providing no guarantees beyond the training data. In this work, we show that by exploiting the action of permutations on the image lattice, we can constrain a neural architecture that is globally nonexpansive (Lipschitz bound $\leqslant 1$). We integrate the proposed denoiser with forward imaging operators to develop a reconstruction mechanism that is provably contractive and therefore globally convergent. Experiments on standard inverse problems, such as superresolution and deblurring, demonstrate that our reconstruction performance is competitive with softly constrained baselines while providing Lipschitz guarantees.

</details>


### [284] [Investigating the Visual Cues of CNNs for Vascular Segmentation: A Case Study in Microscopy and Fundus Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23371)
*Weslley dos Santos Silva,Cesar Henrique Comin*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文通过实验量化了CNN在血管分割任务中对形状、纹理和感受野的依赖程度，发现像素强度比纹理更重要，网络主要依赖约20像素的有效感受野，且无法仅从形状线索外推完整血管几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血管分割是临床诊断的标准流程，但模型决策所依赖的具体视觉特征尚不明确，本文旨在量化分析CNN在血管分割中依赖的视觉线索。

Method: 采用三类实验：1）通过像素打乱和归一化分离纹理和强度；2）使用稀疏轮廓和中心线训练评估形状相关性；3）通过改变网络理论和有效感受野量化所需空间上下文。

Result: 像素强度比纹理更关键，但在两者都被去除时网络仍保持较高准确率；CNN难以从形状线索外推完整血管几何；网络通常依赖约20像素的有效感受野，但全局上下文对眼底图像有适度帮助。

Conclusion: 该研究方法为审计和改进血管成像中的深度学习系统提供了定量基础，但结论仅适用于所评估的特定模态。

Abstract: Vascular segmentation is a standard procedure for clinical diagnosis, yet the specific visual features determining model decisions remain poorly understood. This paper investigates the visual cues Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) use to segment blood vessels across two distinct imaging domains: fluorescence microscopy and retinal fundus photography. We employ a series of experiments to quantify the influence of shape, texture, and receptive field on segmentation performance. First, we isolate texture and intensity by evaluating performance on patches subjected to pixel shuffling and normalization. Second, we assess global shape relevance by training models on sparse contours and centerlines. Lastly, we quantify the required spatial context by systematically varying the network's theoretical and effective receptive fields. Within the scope of the evaluated datasets, we found that pixel intensity is more relevant than texture, though networks maintain surprisingly high accuracy even when both cues are removed. Furthermore, CNNs struggle to extrapolate full vessel geometry from shape cues alone, typically relying on a relatively small effective receptive field of around 20 pixels, though global context provides a modest benefit for fundus images. While specific to the modalities studied, this methodology offers a quantitative foundation to audit and refine deep learning systems in vascular imaging.

</details>


### [285] [Direction-adaptive Mamba: Spatial-Frequency Dual-Domain Collaborative Learning for PolSAR Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23464)
*Junfei Shi,Yu Cheng,Haojia Zhang,Wenqiang Hua,Junhuai Li,Maoguo Gong*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出DA-Mamba框架，通过方向自适应扫描和双域协同学习来解决PolSAR图像分类中现有Mamba方法忽略边缘纹理和固定扫描模式的问题，在三个真实数据集上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PolSAR Mamba方法存在两个关键缺陷：纯空间处理丢弃了细粒度边缘和纹理信息；固定扫描模式无法建模方向变化的各向异性散射和弱边界，难以满足PolSAR物理分析需求。

Method: 1) 边缘对齐的方向自适应扫描方案，捕获长程空间依赖和精确边界细节；2) 采用非下采样轮廓波变换(NSCT)将数据分离为低频全局分量和多方向高频子带；3) 双域协同学习模块融合空间散射与频域表示。

Result: 在三个真实PolSAR数据集上，DA-Mamba超越了当前最先进方法，验证了自适应扫描和双域融合设计的有效性。

Conclusion: 方向自适应Mamba框架结合双域协同学习能有效提升PolSAR分类性能，代码将公开。

Abstract: Deep learning dominates polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) image classification, with Mamba architectures serving as favorable backbones due to linear complexity and strong global modeling capacity. However, existing PolSAR Mamba methods have two critical flaws: pure spatial processing discards fine-grained edges and textures, and fixed scanning patterns fail to model direction-variant anisotropic scattering and weak boundaries essential for PolSAR physical analysis. This work proposes DA-Mamba, a direction-adaptive Mamba framework with dual-domain collaborative learning for PolSAR classification. Equipped with an edge-aligned direction-adaptive scanning scheme, DA-Mamba captures long-range spatial dependencies and accurate boundary details. It adopts the Non-Subsampled Contourlet Transform (NSCT) to separate PolSAR data into low-frequency global components and multi-directional high-frequency subbands, extracting anisotropic structural features from high-frequency information while preserving global context via low-frequency branches. A dual-domain collaborative learning module further integrates spatial scattering and frequency-domain representations to strengthen feature discriminability. Evaluated on three real-world PolSAR datasets, DA-Mamba surpasses state-of-the-art methods, verifying the efficacy of the proposed adaptive scanning and dual-domain fusion designs. Code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [286] [Segmentation Robustness and Predictive Utility in Glioblastoma Radiomics: Evidence for a Trade-off in Survival Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23626)
*Mariya Miteva,Maria Nisheva-Pavlova*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了GBM MRI影像组学特征的稳健性与预测效用的关系，发现特征稳健性筛选并未提升生存预测模型性能，且模型所选特征稳健性反而低于整体特征池，表明稳健性不宜作为特征选择的可靠标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影像组学生物标志物在GBM中广泛应用，但因肿瘤分割变异性导致临床转化受限，需要系统探究特征稳健性与预测效用的关系。

Method: 使用UPENN-GBM队列，从多参数MRI的增强肿瘤、瘤周水肿和坏死核心三个亚区提取4,752个影像组学特征，通过ICC量化稳健性；采用Coxnet、随机生存森林和梯度提升生存分析进行生存预测评估。

Result: 48.1%特征为稳健；影像组学特征相比临床基线无一致提升；稳健性筛选未带来性能增益；模型所选特征稳健性低于整体特征池。

Conclusion: 稳健性本身不能作为影像组学生存建模中特征选择的可靠标准。

Abstract: Radiomic biomarkers derived from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) have been widely investigated as non-invasive tools for tumor characterization and prognostic modeling in glioblastoma (GBM). However, their clinical translation remains limited, in part due to sensitivity to tumor segmentation variability. In this study, we systematically investigate the relationship between feature robustness and predictive utility in GBM survival modeling using the University of Pennsylvania Glioblastoma Imaging, Genomics, and Radiomics (UPENN-GBM) cohort. A total of 4,752 radiomic features were obtained from multiparametric MRI across three tumor subregions: enhancing tumor (ET), peritumoral edema (ED), and necrotic core (NC). Feature robustness was quantified using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) based on the automatic and expert-refined segmentation versions. Among features with valid ICC estimates, 48.1% were classified as robust. Survival prediction was evaluated using cross-validation with Coxnet, Random Survival Forest, and Gradient Boosting Survival Analysis models. In this cohort, radiomic feature inclusion showed no consistent improvement over the clinical baseline, and robustness filtering produced no detectable performance gain. Model-selected features were less robust than the overall feature pool, indicating a lack of enrichment for robustness. These findings suggest that robustness alone is not a reliable criterion for feature selection in radiomics-based survival modelling.

</details>


### [287] [A Controlled Visual-Backbone Benchmark for Multimodal Short-Term Solar Irradiance Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23633)
*Oshadha Samarakoon,Dushan Herath,Ishara Ranmandala,Dilshara Herath,Roshan Godaliyadda,Parakrama Ekanayake,Vijitha Herath*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文在固定多模态预测流水线（仅改变视觉骨干网络）的条件下，系统比较了ConvNeXt、Swin Transformer、VMamba、Spatial Mamba和MambaVision五种骨干在10分钟前瞻地表辐照度预测任务上的表现。实验在Folsom和NREL两个严格数据集上进行，结果显示所有视觉骨干在Folsom数据集上均优于智能持久性基准，但在NREL数据集上智能持久性仍最强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常同时改变多个组件（如图像编码器、时间模型、融合模块、目标定义、训练策略），难以评估单一模块的贡献；本文希望在固定其余所有模块的条件下，仅改变视觉骨干网络，从而提供公平、可复现的骨干网络对比结果。

Method: 固定多模态预测流水线（预处理、晴空指数归一化、天气历史编码、融合模块、回归头、损失函数、优化器调度、随机种子、时间划分策略均不变），仅替换视觉骨干网络（ConvNeXt、Swin Transformer、VMamba、Spatial Mamba、MambaVision），在Folsom和NREL两个严格数据集上进行10分钟前瞻预测实验。评估指标为RMSE，基准为基于晴空指数的智能持久性模型。

Result: 在Folsom严格数据集上，所有视觉骨干均优于智能持久性，最佳结果为VMamba Small（65.39 W/m²）和Swin Base（65.50 W/m²），仅时间序列基线为69.51 W/m²。在NREL严格数据集上，智能持久性仍为最优（17.48 W/m²），最佳视觉骨干Swin Tiny为23.76 W/m²。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一种在固定多模态操作点下的可复现骨干网络对比框架，而非确立架构级别的绝对优势或统计排序；视觉骨干在较小规模数据集上能超越持久性基准，但在更大更严格的数据集上仍需进一步优化。

Abstract: Sky-image irradiance studies often compare forecasting systems in which the image encoder, temporal model, fusion block, target definition, and training recipe all change together. We use a narrower protocol: the multimodal forecasting pipeline is fixed, and only the visual backbone is varied. The shared setup keeps preprocessing, clear-sky-index normalization, weather-history encoding, fusion, regression head, loss, optimizer schedule, seed, and chronological split policy unchanged. We compare ConvNeXt, Swin Transformer, VMamba, Spatial Mamba, and MambaVision backbones for 10min-ahead forecasting on Folsom and a strict matched NREL split. Forecast skill is measured against clear-sky-index smart persistence, and temporal-only rows are reported as weather-history diagnostics rather than as the main ranking criterion. On the Folsom strict split, all evaluated visual-backbone runs improve over smart persistence. In the evaluated single-seed strict runs, VMamba Small and Swin Base reach matched Folsom RMSE values of 65.39 W/m^2 and 65.50 W/m^2; the temporal-only diagnostic reaches 69.51 W/m^2. On the 313-sample NREL strict split, smart persistence remains strongest at 17.48 W/m^2, while the lowest visual RMSE is obtained by Swin Tiny at 23.76 W/m^2. These results provide a reproducible encoder comparison under one fixed multimodal operating point rather than establishing architecture-level dominance, statistically resolved ranking, or fully optimized forecasting performance. Code available here: https://github.com/Oshadha345/irradiance_benchmark

</details>


### [288] [Rapid quantitative chemical composition mapping using model-based MRI reconstruction with field inhomogeneity correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24441)
*Artyom Tsanda,Stefan Benders,Muhammad Adrian,Alexander Penn,Tobias Knopp*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模型的重建框架，通过嵌入化学组分的先验谱知识，加速磁共振波谱成像中的成分映射，可在20秒内以约0.01 mol/mol的偏差和0.09 mol/mol的精度重建摩尔比图，并通过稀疏采样将扫描时间缩短至5秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统化学位移成像因引入额外的谱编码维度导致采集时间过长，难以满足化学工程中快速评估空间成分变化的需求，因此亟需一种快速的空间分辨光谱方法。

Method: 采用基于模型的重建框架，将化学组分的先验谱知识嵌入前向模型中；扩展了以往研究，考虑了主磁场不均匀性；使用2D多梯度回波序列进行体模实验；并引入稀疏k空间采样进一步加速。

Result: 对于单峰和多峰化学组分，该方法均能准确确定摩尔比；20秒扫描的偏差约0.01 mol/mol，精度约0.09 mol/mol；稀疏采样可将扫描缩短至5秒，性能仅轻微下降。

Conclusion: 该方法在保持良好定量性能的同时显著缩短了采集时间，适用于动态过程的化学工程应用。

Abstract: Magnetic resonance spectroscopic imaging methods are particularly attractive for chemical engineering applications, including the monitoring of chemical reactions, where a rapid assessment of spatial variations in chemical composition is required. Conventional approaches, such as chemical shift imaging, introduce an additional spectral-encoding dimension, which substantially increases acquisition time. Consequently, fast spatially resolved spectroscopy remains an active research topic. This work uses a model-based reconstruction framework that embeds a priori spectral knowledge of the involved chemical components into the forward model to accelerate composition mapping. It allows for the reconstruction of molar ratio maps for individual chemical components without acquiring high-resolution spectra. Extending from previous studies, the proposed model accounts for inhomogeneities of the main field, which become more pronounced in systems with larger bores relevant for process engineering. Phantom experiments employing a 2D multi-gradient echo sequence demonstrate the ability to determine molar ratios for chemical components with single peaks as well as multiple peaks in their spectra. The bias and precision of the method remain around 0.01 mol/mol and 0.09 mol/mol, respectively, for a 20 s scan, indicating suitability for dynamic processes. Finally, acquisition time can be reduced further by applying sparse k-space sampling, potentially shortening the scan to 5 s with only minor degradation in quantitative performance.

</details>


### [289] [Efficient Ultrasound Image Segmentation with Token-Conditioned Neural Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24529)
*Fangyijie Wang,Tanya Akumu,Zi Ye,Guénolé Silvestre,Karim Lekadir,Kathleen M. Curran*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出LiteAdaNCA-Net (LANCANet)，一种轻量级超声图像分割框架，通过令牌条件化神经细胞自动机（NCA）适配器实现迭代特征精炼，在保持低计算成本的同时达到与轻量级CNN和Transformer方法相当或更优的分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习超声图像分割方法计算成本高，难以部署在便携式和低资源设备上，亟需一种轻量级且性能优异的分割框架。

Method: 提出LANCANet框架，集成令牌条件化NCA适配器，通过Token FiLM机制利用结构感知令牌引导局部NCA迭代精炼，实现边界感知特征精炼，计算开销极小。

Result: 在HC18和CCA上分别取得96.62%和92.86%的DSC；在PSFHS上耻骨联合结构分割最佳；在外部域迁移数据集KEN-FH和AFR-FH上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 令牌条件化NCA精炼能在保持计算效率的同时提升分割精度和边界定位能力，适用于资源受限的临床部署场景。

Abstract: Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS) plays an important role in bedside diagnosis and clinical decision-making, particularly in resource-constrained settings. Recent deep learning methods have substantially improved ultrasound image segmentation, enabling accurate diagnosis and biometric estimation. However, their computational cost limits deployment on portable and low-resource devices. To address this challenge, we propose LiteAdaNCA-Net (LANCANet), a lightweight ultrasound segmentation framework that incorporates token-conditioned Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) adapters for iterative feature refinement. Specifically, structure-aware tokens guide local NCA refinement via Token FiLM, enabling boundary-aware feature refinement with minimal computational cost. We evaluate LANCANet on HC18, CCA, and PSFHS, and assess robustness on two independent African fetal head datasets collected from multiple clinical centers. Experimental results demonstrate that LANCANet achieves competitive or superior performance to recent lightweight CNN- and transformer-based methods. On HC18 and CCA, LANCANet achieves the highest Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 96.62\% and 92.86\%, respectively. On PSFHS, it achieves the best performance on the challenging pubic symphysis structure while maintaining competitive fetal head segmentation accuracy. Furthermore, despite being trained from scratch, LANCANet maintains competitive performance on the external KEN-FH and AFR-FH datasets under substantial domain shifts. These results show that token-conditioned NCA refinement improves segmentation accuracy and boundary localization while maintaining computational efficiency for resource-constrained clinical deployment. Our code is on \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LANCAN-21A0/README.md}{GitHub}.

</details>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [290] [FedTaste: Topology-Aware Structural Transfer for Multimodal Federated Learning with Missing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23245)
*Haochen Liang,Jie Zhang,Hideya Ochiai*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: FedTaste提出了一种参数高效的拓扑感知结构迁移框架，通过冻结的基础模型提取全局多模态拓扑蓝图，并利用模态自适应结构提示和谱一致性正则化，在不进行显式模态补全的情况下，有效解决多模态联邦学习中任意模态缺失和非独立同分布数据带来的表示漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖生成式补全、外部辅助数据或孤立单模态训练来弥合模态差距，导致通信和计算成本高昂且存在隐私风险，亟需一种轻量级、隐私友好的多模态联邦学习方法。

Method: 1) 利用冻结的基础模型从完整模态客户端提取联合多模态拓扑结构；2) 服务器将拓扑结构整合为全局结构蓝图；3) 引入模态自适应结构提示和谱一致性正则化，实现轻量级分支特定适应，使局部部分表示与全局蓝图对齐。

Result: 在多个数据集和挑战性的Non-IID设置下，FedTaste consistently 取得了优越性能，同时显著降低了通信开销。

Conclusion: FedTaste通过关注稳定的群组级语义关系而非脆弱的一阶特征对齐，避免了显式模态补全，同时保持了跨客户端的共享语义结构，为多模态联邦学习提供了一种高效、隐私友好的新范式。

Abstract: Multimodal Federated Learning is often challenged by arbitrary modality missingness and Non-IID data distributions, which lead to severe representation drift and hinder effective collaboration across clients. Existing methods typically rely on generative imputation, external auxiliary data, or isolated unimodal training to bridge modality gaps, often incurring substantial communication and computational costs as well as potential privacy risks. To address these limitations, we propose FedTaste, a parameter-efficient framework for topology-aware structural transfer in Multimodal Federated Learning with missing modalities. Instead of aligning fragile first-order features, FedTaste focuses on more stable group-level semantic relations. Specifically, FedTaste leverages frozen foundation models to extract a joint multimodal topology from full-modality clients, which is then consolidated by the server into a global structural blueprint. To adapt clients with missing modalities, we introduce Modality-Adaptive Structural Prompts together with spectral consistency regularization, enabling lightweight branch-specific adaptation that aligns local partial representations with the shared blueprint. In this way, FedTaste avoids explicit modality imputation while preserving shared semantic structure across clients. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedTaste consistently achieves superior performance across multiple datasets and challenging Non-IID settings, while substantially reducing communication overhead compared with existing methods.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [291] [Concept-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22544)
*Yassine Oueslati,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出C-VCE框架，将分类器直接集成到扩散模型的概念瓶颈层中，通过人类可解释的概念引导生成反事实解释，无需依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器，在保持图像质量的同时实现高效的概念控制编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的反事实解释方法依赖外部分类器处理噪声图像，脆弱且难以部署；需要一种将分类能力内置于生成模型、无需额外噪声鲁棒分类器的反事实生成方案。

Method: 在扩散模型中引入概念瓶颈层，将分类器直接构建在生成模型内部；通过开关语义概念控制采样过程；添加概率正则化项平衡预测翻转与图像保真度；使用梯度掩码限制编辑区域。

Result: 在CelebA等基准上，C-VCE达到或超过基线方法的翻转率，同时生成的反事实图像在视觉上更接近原始输入，失真更小。

Conclusion: 暴露并控制内部概念层是使生成模型更易理解和安全使用的有效途径，C-VCE为需要具体"假设"图像的安全关键视觉系统提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to answer "what minimal change to this image would flip the model's prediction?", and are increasingly important as vision models are deployed in safety-critical domains (e.g., medicine). Existing diffusion-based methods can produce realistic edits, but they rely on external classifiers that must work reliably on noisy images, which makes them fragile and hard to deploy for robust explanations. We introduce C-VCE, a new diffusion framework that builds the classifier directly into the generative model via a concept bottleneck layer, so that counterfactuals are guided by human-interpretable features (concepts) instead of a separate noise robust classifier that works with pixel-level edits. Our model lets users to toggle on/off semantic concepts during sampling, then minimally adjusts relevant image regions, while preserving the rest of the image, respecting feature correlations. To keep edits small and controlled, we add a simple probabilistic regularizer that balances "change the prediction" against "stay close to the original", plus a gradient-based mask that confines modifications to the most relevant regions. On benchmarks such as CelebA, C-VCE matches or improves flip rates while producing counterfactuals that are visually closer to the input and less distorted than baselines that depend on separate noisy-image classifiers. These properties make C-VCE a practical tool for vision systems where users need concrete "what-if" images without having to trust an additional, noise-robust classifier. More broadly, our results suggest that exposing and controlling an internal concept layer is a promising way to make powerful generative models easier to understand and safer to use.

</details>


### [292] [SeT-Diff: Towards Semantic Foundation Models for HPC Telemetry and Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22548)
*Giovanni B. Esposito,Francesco Antici,Daniele Cesarini,Andrea Bartolini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SeT-Diff，首个面向计算节点遥测数据的基础扩散模型，通过语义条件生成实现零样本传感器排列稳定性，在重构、插补、预测和虚拟感知任务上均表现优异，可作为HPC系统的数据驱动数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HPC机器学习方法依赖静态、固定位置的传感器变量子集，仅适用于单一任务；当目标任务变化或传感器指标改变时，模型随之失效，缺乏灵活性和泛化能力。

Method: 提出SeT-Diff扩散模型，将生成过程条件化于每个传感器的语义描述，从而将系统动力学与数据集结构解耦，实现任务无关的灵活建模。

Result: 在真实超算数据集上，重构MAE达0.0470；具备零样本排列稳定性（传感器打乱后精度几乎无下降）；单一预训练模型在插补、预测和虚拟感知任务中均有效，热推断MAE为0.033。

Conclusion: SeT-Diff作为一种数据驱动的数字孪生方法，能够准确、灵活地建模HPC系统，适应任务和传感器配置的动态变化。

Abstract: Data centers and their compute nodes require accurate and flexible digital twins capable of modeling the complex interplay of workloads, environmental parameters, and physical metrics. Current machine learning approaches for HPC and its telemetry typically rely on a static subset of anonymous, fixed-position sensor variables tailored to single tasks. Consequently, these models become obsolete when target tasks change or sensor metrics vary. We propose SeT-Diff, the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series. Unlike rigid architectures, our diffusion-based approach conditions the generative process on each sensor's semantic description, decoupling the system dynamics from the structure of the dataset. Experiments on a real-world supercomputer dataset demonstrate a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0470 on reconstruction tasks. SeT-Diff exhibits zero-shot permutation stability, maintaining accuracy with negligible degradation even when sensors are shuffled. A single pre-trained model effectively performs data imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing - achieving a 0.033 MAE in thermal inference - making SeT-Diff an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.

</details>


### [293] [QFoldAgent: An Autonomous Quantum Optimization Multi-Agent System for Protein Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22549)
*Winson Chen,Yuqi Zhang,Sixu Chen,Nuo Xu,Qiang Guan,Caiwen Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出QFoldAgent，一个用于5残基四面体晶格折叠的闭环多智能体框架，通过设计智能体、VQE量子-经典管线和反馈智能体迭代优化哈密顿量惩罚权重，在QDockBank基准上中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，在未见序列上结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于晶格的量子-经典蛋白质结构预测工作通常手动固定哈密顿量惩罚权重，且仅在极短片段上进行模拟评估，缺乏系统的迭代优化方法。

Method: 提出QFoldAgent闭环多智能体框架，包含三个智能体：(1) 设计智能体提出序列条件惩罚系数；(2) VQE量子-经典管线在Qiskit Aer噪声下优化哈密顿量；(3) 反馈智能体利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号跨周期精炼惩罚系数。使用QDockBank的55个已知结构片段和100个覆盖率优化的未见序列进行验证。

Result: QDockBank基准上中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å；未见序列上结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，87%的初始无效案例得到恢复，最强控制器在87%的序列上改善了周期3能量，同时维持96%的Ramachandran偏好几何。

Conclusion: 迭代智能体控制能够系统性地改进5残基量子环境下的优化行为并减少失败案例。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical protein structure prediction depends strongly on Hamiltonian penalty weights, yet existing lattice-based workflows typically fix these coefficients by hand and evaluate only very short fragments in simulation. We present QFoldAgent, a closed-loop multi-agent framework for 5-residue tetrahedral-lattice folding in which a design agent proposes sequence-conditioned penalties, a VQE-based quantum-classical pipeline optimizes the resulting Hamiltonian under Qiskit Aer noise, and a feedback agent uses energy-landscape diagnostics and MolProbity validation signals to refine penalties across cycles. Ground-truth metrics such as RMSD are never exposed to the agents and are used only for evaluation. We study the framework on two complementary datasets: 55 QDockBank-derived fragments with known structures and 100 coverage-optimized unseen sequences. On the QDockBank benchmark, QFoldAgent reduces median RMSD from 3.64 Å to 3.20 Å, with the largest gains on the hardest targets. On unseen sequences, the closed loop raises structural validity from 87.5% to 98.7%, recovers 87% of initially invalid cases, and the strongest controller improves cycle-3 energy on 87% of sequences while maintaining 96% Ramachandran-favored geometry. These results show that iterative agent control can systematically improve optimization behavior and reduce failure cases in a 5-residue quantum setting.

</details>


### [294] [CachedSearch: Training-Free Cached Exploration for Test-Time Search in Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23159)
*Shreshth Saini,Neil Birkbeck,Yilin Wang,Balu Adsumilli,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CachedSearch方法，通过训练无关的缓存加速视频扩散模型的测试时搜索，在保持近无损质量的同时降低63%的计算成本，并在多个模型家族上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时搜索虽能让小视频扩散模型媲美大模型，但计算成本高昂（2-10倍），且大多数候选样本在完全去噪后被丢弃。现有缓存加速方法可能破坏验证器的排序可靠性，而该问题尚未被研究。

Method: 首先系统研究缓存是否破坏候选排序（Spearman秩相关0.905，72% top-1一致），发现错误集中在几乎持平的候选中，具有自限性。基于此提出CachedSearch：先用激进缓存探索所有候选，再对胜出者用全计算重新生成。可在不同模型家族间迁移（仅需校准一个参数）。

Result: N=8时，CachedSearch以63%成本捕获94.7%的best-of-N收益；在相同预算下，搜索宽度翻倍，收益提升38%；中间轨迹剪枝进一步将探索加速提升至3.11倍，捕获率88.6%；在1.3B-14B的6个模型、4个家族（Wan, LTX, CogVideoX, Hunyuan）上验证有效。

Conclusion: CachedSearch是一种训练无关、验证器无关、与搜索算法正交的即插即用加速方法，可作为测试时扩展的倍增器。缓存导致的排名错误具有自限性（集中在几乎持平的候选中），为安全使用缓存提供了理论支持。

Abstract: Test-time search lets small video diffusion models rival larger ones, but costs 2-10x more. All candidates are fully denoised, although most are discarded. Training-free caching makes each rollout 2-3x faster at near-lossless quality. Composition is safe only if lossy caching preserves verifier rankings. We present the first study of whether caching corrupts candidate ranking in video test-time search. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B with an adaptive caching wrapper (~2x per-candidate speedup), ImageReward scores seed-matched cached and full rollouts. Median per-prompt Spearman rank correlation is 0.905, with 72% top-1 agreement on the VBench suite. VBench-2.0 replicates this result on a harder suite. Recomputing the cached winner at full compute retains 90-94% of the full-search gain. Errors cluster among near-tied candidates, making corruption self-limiting. This finding leads to CachedSearch. It explores every candidate with aggressive caching, then re-generates only the winner at full compute. At N=8, it captures 94.7% of best-of-N's gain at 63% of the cost. Capture rises with width. At matched budget, it searches twice as wide for 38% more gain. The result holds from 1.3B-14B across six models and four families: Wan, LTX, CogVideoX, and Hunyuan. Wan2.1-14B matches the 1.3B model's fidelity. Mid-trajectory pruning multiplies the exploration saving to 3.11x at 88.6% capture. Ports to other model families require recalibrating a single parameter, showing that fidelity tracks architecture rather than parameter count. CachedSearch is training-free, verifier-agnostic, and orthogonal to the search algorithm, making it a plug-in multiplier for test-time scaling.

</details>


### [295] [Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22554)
*Kazem Faghih,Yize Cheng,Shoumik Saha,Mobina Pournemat,Armin Gerami,Soheil Feizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLMs在标准基准测试中表现良好，但在不同措辞的等效问题下，模型答案经常发生变化，单次提示的正确性无法可靠反映其真实知识掌握程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究LLMs在面对语义等价的改写问题时，其答案是否稳定，以及单次评测的准确性是否能真实反映模型的知识可靠程度。

Method: 在四个基准和13个模型上，对事实问答和数学推理任务进行意义保持的改写，比较模型在不同措辞下的答案一致性，并利用自改写策略提升性能。

Result: 模型输出高度依赖措辞，实例级答案不匹配率超过23%；但至少有一个改写版本能获得正确答案，表明知识存在但检索不一致。

Conclusion: 标准准确率指标可能掩盖了模型的不稳定性，评估同等输入下的一致性才能更清晰地反映LLM的可靠性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. In this work, we study how model answers change under meaning-preserving paraphrases across factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across four benchmarks and 13 models, we find that model outputs frequently depend on the exact wording of the prompt. While overall accuracy typically changes only modestly across paraphrases, instance-level behavior is far less stable: for many questions, models alternate between correct and incorrect answers depending on phrasing, with mismatch rates reaching more than 23%. Conditioning on questions that are answered correctly in their original form reveals even larger failures measured by answer flip rates, showing that single-prompt correctness is often a poor indicator of reliability. At the same time, we find that models often produce a correct answer for at least one paraphrase of a question, suggesting that the underlying knowledge is present but inconsistently retrieved. Building on this observation, we show that a simple self-paraphrasing strategy can partially recover this latent knowledge and improve performance at inference time. Together, these findings suggest that standard accuracy metrics can mask substantial instability, and that evaluating consistency across equivalent inputs provides a clearer picture of LLM reliability.

</details>


### [296] [DeepLens Diagnosis Agent: Agentic Workflow Design Lets a Small Reasoning Model Compete with Frontier LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22555)
*Mahmood Bayeshi,Veysel Kocaman,Muhammed Ali Naqvi,Yigit Gul,David Talby*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DeepLenz诊断智能体，通过五阶段流程（结构化提取、检索增强、候选生成、证据三角验证、最终决策）结合小型医学推理模型（JSL Medical Small 7B v2）与RAG，在DiagnosisArena基准上达到60.14%的Top-1诊断准确率，比无流程的同一模型提升36个点，且成本低于Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro，同时性能超越它们。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM虽为强通用模型，但在医疗诊断这一多阶段复杂推理任务中，单次提示往往产生脆弱的诊断推理结果，缺乏结构化流程约束，导致准确率低下且不可审计。

Method: 提出五阶段诊断智能体流程：(1) 结构化临床提取，(2) 约束检索（RAG），(3) 受限候选生成，(4) 显式证据三角验证，(5) 可审计最终决策。核心模型为JSL Medical Small 7B v2小模型。

Result: DiagnosisArena基准Top-1准确率60.14%，为中小型模型最高；流程设计带来+36个百分点的提升（23.99%→60.14%）；每例成本0.0072美元，延迟24秒；比Claude Sonnet 4.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro分别高9.70pp和9.17pp，且成本低35-45%。

Conclusion: 结构化流程约束比模型参数规模或API成本更能提升诊断推理质量；流程产生可审计的中间产物，支持错误定位与高可靠性场景应用。

Abstract: Medical diagnosis is a multi-stage process: extract facts, consult knowledge, generate a differential analysis, and select the best diagnosis with explanations. Frontier LLMs are strong generalists, but single-shot prompting often yields brittle diagnostic reasoning. We present the DeepLens Diagnosis Agent, a five-stage harnessing pipeline (combining model capabilities with disciplined process constraints) centered on a small medical reasoning model (JSL Medical Small 7B v2) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The pipeline enforces structured clinical extraction, disciplined retrieval, constrained candidate generation, explicit evidence triangulation, and an auditable final decision. On the 915-case DiagnosisArena benchmark, the agent achieved 60.14% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, the highest among small and medium-sized models. The same model without the agent workflow achieved 23.99%, a +36-point gain from workflow design alone, despite 88.2% on standard medical benchmarks, showing that diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty requires more than knowledge recall. The agent costs USD 0.0072 per case (24K tokens on A100) with 24-second latency, 35-45% cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 (USD 0.0110) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (USD 0.0128) while outperforming them by +9.70pp and +9.17pp. Harnessing can also correct frontier model failures; workflow constraints can outweigh parameter count or API cost.
  Beyond aggregate accuracy, the pipeline produces structured intermediate artifacts that make each stage inspectable and support error localization. These properties support high-stakes settings where traceability, reproducibility, and auditable evidence matter alongside benchmark performance.

</details>


### [297] [MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22556)
*Dong Li,Yanchi Liu,Xujiang Zhao,Wei Cheng,Zhengzhang Chen,Xintao Wu,Zhong Chen,Chen Zhao,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MIITA是一种内存驱动的推理时自适应框架，通过存储压缩修正方向原型和语义锚点，在推理时进行门控临时隐藏状态调整，使小语言模型在资源受限的监督持续学习中有效缓解灾难性遗忘，无需更新主干网络或扩展提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型在资源受限部署中面临持续学习需求，但直接更新有限参数空间会导致灾难性遗忘；现有针对大语言模型的内存方法依赖大量存储和强大的上下文推理能力，小语言模型不具备这些条件。

Method: MIITA框架：将监督经验存储为紧凑的修正方向原型和语义锚点；推理时基于语义和不确定性线索检索；通过门控临时隐藏状态调整应用检索到的方向，实现无破坏性的过去监督复用。

Result: 在多种监督持续学习设置下的广泛实验表明，MIITA在固定内存预算下持续提升了最终性能并缓解了灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: MIITA通过局部理论分析与损失降低、不确定性引导检索和方向覆盖相关联，为小语言模型在资源受限环境下的持续学习提供了有效且无需反向传播的解决方案。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, we propose MIITA, a Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation framework for supervised CL under constrained storage. MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors, and retrieves them at inference time using semantic and uncertainty-based cues. The retrieved directions are applied through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation, enabling non-destructive reuse of past supervision without backbone updates, prompt extensions, or test-time backpropagation. A local theoretical analysis links this design to first-order loss reduction, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and directional coverage for retaining old-stage knowledge. Extensive experiments across diverse supervised CL settings show that MIITA consistently improves final performance and mitigates forgetting under fixed memory budgets.

</details>


### [298] [Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22561)
*Tzu-Heng Huang,Shengqi Qiu,Frederic Sala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PAJAMA系统，通过程序蒸馏将LLM评估逻辑转化为可编程的评判委员会，在降低成本和延迟的同时保持或提升评估性能，并可作为奖励信号使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge方法存在高成本、高延迟和决策不透明的问题，限制了其可扩展性和可靠性，亟需更高效、可解释的替代方案。

Method: 提出程序蒸馏方法，将LLM的决策逻辑蒸馏为可编程的评判程序；构建PAJAMA系统，包含程序合成、联合裁决聚合和低置信度回退机制（回退到LLM）。

Result: 在5个数据集和4个模型家族上，程序化评判器可匹配13B规模LLM评判器的性能；PAJAMA在准确率和吞吐量上均提升了帕累托前沿；在RewardBench上，基于程序裁决蒸馏的奖励模型性能超越基于专有LLM标签训练的模型，且API成本低两个数量级。

Conclusion: 程序蒸馏是一种高效、透明、低成本的LLM评估替代方案，且能够产生高质量奖励信号，具有良好的实用价值。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.

</details>


### [299] [SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22562)
*Ning Yang,Siqi Li,Miaoxin Shen,Yuan Zhou,Meng Zhang,Tong Li,Haijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SF-AMS通过效用驱动的记忆存活机制和复合重要性评分，替代静态检索与启发式衰减，在LLM智能体中实现紧凑、高价值的长期记忆管理，在多跳推理等任务上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文依赖是LLM智能体的主要瓶颈，冗余和无关信息会降低多步推理质量，现有记忆管理方法依赖静态检索和启发式衰减，缺乏对记忆单元长期重要性的动态建模。

Method: 提出SF-AMS框架，核心包括：(1) 效用驱动的存活机制，从使用冗余度和时间信号更新记忆重要性，形成层级记忆结构；(2) 复合重要性评分，融合语义与实体层面的信号以提升检索鲁棒性。

Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s上全面超越LightMem、MemO、A-Mem等基线。Qwen2.5-7B下多跳推理F1提升+9.65，GPT-4o-mini下时序推理F1提升+6.91，开放域任务F1提升+6.53，且跨骨干网络泛化性强。

Conclusion: 将记忆重要性建模为动态效用信号，对于实现可靠的长上下文推理至关重要。

Abstract: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure that prioritizes stable entity-consistent information while filtering noise. On top of this, Composite Importance Scoring integrates semantic and entity level signals to improve retrieval robustness. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s show consistent gains over strong state of the art baselines including LightMem MemO and A-Mem. The largest improvement appears in multi-hop reasoning under Qwen2.5-7B where SF-AMS achieves plus 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline followed by temporal reasoning under GPT-4o-mini plus 6.91 F1 and open-domain tasks plus 6.53 F1 demonstrating strong cross backbone generalization. These results show that modeling memory importance as a dynamic utility signal is critical for reliable long-context reasoning.

</details>


### [300] [Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22563)
*Sagar Chethan Kumar,Rohith Kanathur,Dhaval Patel,Kaoutar El Maghraoui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent，一种基于IEC标准的高效合成工业智能体场景生成流程，能将Smart Grid Transformer场景生成速度提升8倍，同时保持场景质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业智能体基准测试（如AssetOpsBench）依赖人工编写场景，覆盖资产类别有限，缺乏高效、可扩展的场景生成方法。

Method: 提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent流程，包括证据驱动的资产画像构建、覆盖感知的场景预算分配、混合验证-修复循环（确保模式有效性、工具可达性、物理合理性、标准对齐和去重），以及两级缓存、并行焦点组生成、线程池卸载、批量LLM调用和早期拒绝过滤等优化策略。

Result: 在Smart Grid Transformer场景生成中，50个场景的端到端运行时间减少8倍，复合质量评分74.2±1.9，与未优化基线73.8±3.0相当。

Conclusion: 基于标准的合成场景生成能够高效扩展工业智能体基准测试，且不影响场景质量。

Abstract: Industrial agent benchmarks require realistic evaluation scenarios that integrate telemetry, failure modes, maintenance records, and domain standards. However, existing benchmarks such as AssetOpsBench rely on manually authored scenarios and cover a limited set of asset classes. We extend AssetOpsBench with a Smart Grid Transformer asset class and four IEC-grounded diagnostic tools for health-index prediction, dissolved-gas analysis, winding-temperature assessment, and load-profile assessment. We further introduce ScenarioGeneratorAgent, a pipeline for synthetic industrial-agent scenario generation. The pipeline constructs evidence-grounded asset profiles, allocates coverage-aware scenario budgets across operational domains, and generates candidates through a hybrid validation-and-repair loop that enforces schema validity, tool reachability, physical plausibility, standards alignment, and deduplication. To improve scalability, we apply two-level caching, parallel focus-group generation, thread-pool offloading, batched LLM calls, and early rejection filtering. On Smart Grid Transformer scenario generation, these optimizations reduce end-to-end runtime by $8\times$ for 50 scenarios while preserving quality, achieving a composite quality score of $74.2 \pm 1.9$ compared with $73.8 \pm 3.0$ for the unoptimized baseline. These results show that standards-grounded synthetic scenario generation can efficiently expand industrial-agent benchmarks without sacrificing scenario quality.

</details>


### [301] [Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22564)
*Salem Ameen,Sunil Vadera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多臂老虎机的损失感知特征图剪枝框架，通过将每个候选特征图视为一个臂，在固定预算内评估并永久移除冗余特征图及其对应滤波器，从而在保持准确率的同时减少卷积计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卷积神经网络中存在大量冗余特征图，增加了存储和推理成本，需要一种有效的结构化剪枝方法来去除这些冗余。

Method: 采用多臂老虎机框架进行损失感知的特征图剪枝：每个候选特征图被视为一个臂；每次选择一个特征图临时掩蔽，在采样的mini-batch上评估损失变化，然后恢复并转换为安全移除奖励；固定预算后根据学习得分永久移除top-k特征图及其滤波器、偏置和对应下一层输入通道内核。

Result: UCB1和Thompson Sampling在移除特征图并减少卷积计算的同时，保持了接近未剪枝模型的准确率；Friedman和Nemenyi检验显示UCB1获得最高平均排名，两者显著优于贪心剪枝和基于幅度的剪枝，且与原始未剪枝模型无统计显著性差异。

Conclusion: 基于多臂老虎机的剪枝方法能够在结构化剪枝中有效平衡损失变化与剪枝效率，为CNN模型压缩提供了新的有效途径。

Abstract: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits. Feature-map pruning is structured because it removes complete convolutional output channels and their producing filters rather than isolated scalar weights. Each candidate feature map is treated as an arm. At each play time, one map is temporarily masked and evaluated on a sampled mini-batch; the map is then restored and the observed loss change is converted into a safe-removal reward. After a fixed play budget, candidate maps are ranked by learned scores and the top-k maps are permanently removed with their filters, biases and corresponding next-layer input-channel kernels. The study evaluates UCB1 and Thompson Sampling, compares them with direct/oracle-style evaluation on LeNet/MNIST, and extends the evaluation to MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, CUB-200-2011 and Oxford Flowers 102. Results show that UCB1 and Thompson Sampling preserve accuracy close to unpruned models while removing feature maps and reducing convolutional computation. Friedman and Nemenyi tests show that UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank, followed by Thompson Sampling; both significantly outperform greedy and magnitude-based pruning while remaining statistically comparable to the original unpruned model.

</details>


### [302] [DSTFView: Multi-View Cloud-Edge Workload Forecasting with Dual-Input Spatio-Temporal-Frequency Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22565)
*Qingzhong Li,Hui Ma,Yajun Zhang,Qingchang Ma,Zhou Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DSTFView框架，通过双输入时空频多视图建模，在云边协同环境下实现更准确的工作负载预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以在云边协同环境中平衡多维特征建模与预测效率，无法同时处理延迟敏感、高并发和可靠性关键的应用需求。

Method: 提出DSTFView框架，包含双输入机制联合建模邻近依赖与周期依赖，提取时空频三域特征，并设计自适应融合机制动态调整各视图贡献以捕捉突变。

Result: 在CPU和TP数据集上，DSTFView在多个预测时域和评估指标上均优于代表性基线方法。

Conclusion: DSTFView有效解决了云边协同环境下的工作负载预测难题，通过多视图融合提升了预测准确性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: With the widespread deployment of edge-side AI inference, edge platforms are increasingly required to support latency-sensitive, highly concurrent, and reliability-critical applications. However, existing methods often struggle to balance multidimensional feature modeling and forecasting efficiency in collaborative cloud-edge environments. To address this issue, we propose DSTFView, a dual-input spatio-temporal-frequency multi-view workload forecasting framework for collaborative cloud-edge environments. It jointly models closeness and period dependencies and extracts spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain dependencies. Besides, it designs an adaptive fusion mechanism and adjusts the contribution of each view to capture abrupt changes. Experimental results on the CPU and TP datasets demonstrate that DSTFView consistently outperforms representative baselines across multiple forecasting horizons and evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [303] [MedLoCoMo: A Long-Context Multi-Session Medical Dialogue Benchmark for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22566)
*Zeyu Zhang,Ziqing Wang,Kaize Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedLoCoMo是一个面向多入院医疗对话中患者特定临床推理的长上下文记忆基准，包含100条患者时间线，平均每条对话1669.8轮、29.7次就诊、74512.2个token，实验表明跨入院推理始终比局部证据使用更困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗QA基准主要测试短上下文知识或单文档 grounding，缺乏评估LLM在纵向患者病史中使用、连接和放弃推理的能力。

Method: 从MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV-Note去标识记录构建入院级别临床包，合成医患对话，生成单次入院、跨入院和对抗性不可回答三类证据链接QA。

Result: 跨入院推理始终比局部证据使用更困难，即使模型具有长上下文窗口或使用外部记忆/检索方法。

Conclusion: MedLoCoMo揭示了现有LLM在长上下文医疗推理中的不足，为构建更有效的临床推理系统提供了基准和方向。

Abstract: MedLoCoMo is a Medical Long-Context Memory benchmark for patient-specific clinical reasoning over multi-admission medical dialogue. Existing medical QA benchmarks largely test short context knowledge or single document grounding, leaving open whether LLMs can use, connect, and abstain over longitudinal patient histories. We build MedLoCoMo from deidentified MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-Note records by constructing admission-level clinical packets, synthesizing grounded doctor-patient conversations, and generating evidence linked QA items over single-admission, cross-admission, and adversarial unanswerable settings.
